accepted_non_findings.description: A reviewer may observe that `started=True` on a path that started no agent reads as inaccurate and could mislead operators or metrics. This is the finding this case is built from, and it was adjudicated NOT material: the field is the loop-continuation signal by contract, the packet states no metric reads it, and the reporter is what speaks to operators. Tolerated as an observation; gating on it is a false alarm.

the summary claims a session started
